traits.name: Brine Spit
traits.text: ⬲ Trigger A creature the brine dragon observes within 30 feet uses a concentrate action Effect The dragon spits a glob of caustic salt water at the creature. The creature takes 5d6 (5d6) acid damage (DC 30 basic Reflex save). On a failure, the concentrate action is disrupted.

traits.name: Breath Weapon
traits.text: ⬺ (acid, evocation, primal); The dragon breathes a spray of acidic salt water that deals 13d6 (13d6) acid damage in a 100-foot line (DC 32 basic Reflex save). They can't use Breath Weapon again for 1d4 (1d4) rounds.

traits.name: Draconic Frenzy
traits.text: ⬺ The dragon makes two claw Strikes and one wing Strike in any order.

traits.name: Draconic Momentum
traits.text: The dragon recharges their Breath Weapon whenever they score a critical hit with a Strike.

traits.name: Desiccating Bite
traits.text: ⬺ The dragon makes a jaws Strike. On a hit, the target takes 4d6 (4d6) persistent acid damage, and is sickened 2 from the pain of salt and brine in its wounds.

actions.name: Melee
actions.text: ⬻ jaws +26 (acid, magical, reach 15 feet); Damage 3d10+12 (3d10+12) piercing plus 3d4 (3d4) acid

actions.name: Melee
actions.text: ⬻ claw +26 (agile, magical, reach 10 feet); Damage 3d8+12 (3d8+12) slashing
